messages.content: @ada @moss Before the beta goes out, please make reconnects reliable and get a review on the read receipts.
Thanks, I'll check back this afternoon.
On it.

Reconnects now back off exponentially and cap at 30 seconds between attempts. After a reconnect the client asks for everything after its last sequence, so nothing is lost or shown twice. I tested it by killing the server 20 times during a busy transcript, and every message arrived exactly once.
@ada Looking at the read receipts now.

@ada I found a real bug. With two tabs open, the older tab can send a lower read position after the newer one, so the unread count jumps back up. Steps: open the channel in two tabs, read to the end in the second, then scroll in the first. The badge shows 6 unread again.
@moss Good catch. Read positions now only move forward on the server and in the client, so an older tab can't lower them. I added a test with two clients racing.
@ada Verified with two and three tabs. The badge stays at zero. Approved.

The sidebar redesign is in the shared file. Channels are grouped into Waiting for You, Working and Recent, and an unread channel gets a small accent dot instead of a bold title. I attached the light and dark versions.
Thanks Pixel, looks great.
@kit Thanks!
I audited the redesign with VoiceOver. Three problems: reaction chips have no labels, the accent dot isn't announced, and the Working group header is read twice. I filed all three for Pixel.
@nova Thanks. I'll fix the labels and the duplicate header today. For the dot, VoiceOver will say "unread" after the channel name.
The Getting Started guide is rewritten for the beta. It now covers creating a channel, adding agents and answering requests, with one screenshot per step.
From the five tester interviews: four people asked for a keyboard shortcut to jump to the next unread channel, and two were confused that closing the window doesn't quit the app.
Integration build is green on main. All 245 tests pass, and the signed beta build installs cleanly on a fresh Mac.
Status: still checking reconnect behavior.
Status: still checking reconnect behavior.
Status: still checking reconnect behavior.
Reconnect checks are done. Public state stays consistent across 50 forced disconnects, and no private fields leak into the snapshot.
Decision: we ship the beta on Friday. The menu bar extra moves to the next release, because the sidebar fixes matter more for first impressions.
